overall_assessment: Section extraction works well for hivolda: course_content, learning_outcomes (all three sub-groups kept), teaching_methods, coursework_requirements and prerequisites are correctly split and clean in all 20 courses, including the 6 random controls. The main defect is that assessment is only the raw Vurderingsform table dump (header row glued to content, trailing 'Ingen'). Most pre-pass flags are false alarms.

findings.evidence: Vurderingsform Gruppering Varighet Karakterskala Andel Kommentar Hjelpemidler Omfang Munnleg eksamen Individuell 30 minutt A-F, der A er best og E er siste ståkarakter
findings.description: Assessment in every course is a flattened HTML table: the column-header row (Vurderingsform Gruppering Varighet Karakterskala Andel Kommentar Hjelpemidler Omfang) is concatenated with the data row on a single line with no cell separators, so fields like duration, grade scale, weight (e.g. '100') and aids ('Ingen') cannot be told apart. It is also exam-logistics content (duration, grade scale) rather than a description of the assessment. The pre-pass 'boilerplate' flag is a symptom: the identical header string plus identical exam row appear in >=25 courses. The content is correct and complete, but noisy.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The table is flattened by the text extraction step (R/extract_fulltext.R, hivolda config, no .add_table_cell_breaks pre_fn), so the section splitter receives the table as one line; the sections step maps it to assessment verbatim.
findings.suggested_fix: Enable cell/row breaks for hivolda tables (pre_fn = .add_table_cell_breaks in R/institution_config.R) and strip the fixed header string 'Vurderingsform Gruppering Varighet Karakterskala Andel Kommentar Hjelpemidler Omfang' in .clean_sections(); optionally drop the grade-scale phrase 'A-F, der A er best og E er siste ståkarakter'.

findings.description: The EN2A plan lists portfolio composition and weighting (grammar 20 %, other two 40 % each) inside 'Vilkår for å framstille seg til eksamen', so the whole block, including the description of what is graded as the exam, is filed as coursework_requirements. Per the codebook, graded exam content belongs to assessment, while the approve/gate items belong to coursework_requirements. The assessment row then only holds the table.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The splitter cuts by heading only; the 'Vilkår for å framstille seg til eksamen' block is mapped wholesale to coursework_requirements, with no sentence-level separation.
findings.suggested_fix: Accept as a limitation, or add a post-rule that moves sentences about portfolio weighting/delivery as exam from coursework_requirements to assessment. Low priority.
